verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official Stripe CLI that 'helps you build, test, and manage your Stripe integration right from the terminal,' and a probe confirms the official CLI docs page. Since Terminal is a Stripe product, this credits it, but nothing in the evidence shows the CLI covering Terminal-specific workflows such as readers, locations or simulated payments. missing for 10: evidence of Terminal-specific CLI commands (reader management, simulated reader testing), documentation of AI/agent-oriented CLI usage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Stripe CLI helps you build, test, and manage your Stripe integration right from the terminal.
